content.stem: 在反洗钱调查的背景下,关于数据隐私的哪项陈述最为准确？

options.A: 组织在向相关金融情报机构(FIU)提交可疑活动报告之前,必须证明客户已同意信息共享.
options.B: 任何成为可疑报告对象的客户均有权要求对其个人数据进行遮蔽处理.
options.C: 金融情报机构应记录可疑活动报告中所包含的个人数据与其他机构共享的目的.
options.D: 数据隐私法禁止金融机构在所有司法管辖区为反洗钱调查目的而共享信息.

content.stem_en: Which statement regarding data privacy is the most accurate in the context of AML investigations?

options_en.A: Organizations are required to demonstrate that customers have opted into information sharing before submitting suspicious activity reports to relevant Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs)
options_en.B: Any customer that is the subject of a suspicious report filing has the right to request redaction of their personal data
options_en.C: FIUs should document purposes for which personal data included in suspicious activity reports may be shared with other agencies
options_en.D: Data privacy laws prohibit financial institutions from sharing information for AML investigation purposes in all jurisdictions
